myself a beggar And so I am Then crushing penury Persuades me I was better when a king Then am I kinged again and by and by Think that I am unkinged by Bolingbroke And straight am nothing But whateer I be Nor I nor any man that but man is With nothing shall be pleased till he be eased With being nothing Music do I hear Music Ha ha keep time How sour sweet music is When time is broke and no proportion kept So is it in the music of mens lives And here have I the daintiness of ear To check time broke in a disordered string But for the concord of my state and time Had not an ear to hear my true time broke I wasted time and now doth time waste me For now hath time made me his numbring clock My thoughts are minutes and with sighs they jar Their watches on unto mine eyes the outward watch Whereto my finger like a dials point Is pointing still in cleansing them from tears Now sir the sound that tells what hour it is Are clamorous groans which strike upon my heart Which is the bell So sighs and tears and groans Show minutes times and hours But my time Runs posting on in Bolingbrokes proud joy While I stand fooling here his Jack o the clock This music mads me Let it sound no more For though it have holp madmen to their wits In me it seems it will make wise men mad Yet blessing on his heart that gives it me For tis a sign of love and love to Richard Is a strange brooch in this
